
'''Ōyamadera''' (大山寺, also read as Oyamaji, Daisenji, and Taisanji) is a {{ill|Buddhism|en|Buddhism|qid=Q748|lt=Buddhist}} {{ill|Temple|en|Temple|qid=Q44539|lt=Temple}}. Temples with this name exist in various locations across Japan.

== Temples ==

* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Shirosato, Ibaraki)|ja|大山寺 (茨城県城里町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Shirosato, Ibaraki)|qq=}} - A temple located in {{ill|Shirosato, Ibaraki|en|Shirosato, Ibaraki|qid=Q1203068|lt=Shirosato}}, {{ill|Higashiibaraki District, Ibaraki|en|Higashiibaraki District, Ibaraki|qid=Q1154667|lt=Higashiibaraki District}}, {{ill|Ibaraki Prefecture|en|Ibaraki Prefecture|qid=Q83273|lt=Ibaraki Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Tochigi)|ja|大山寺 (栃木市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Tochigi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A temple located in [[:en:Tochigi, Tochigi|Tochigi City]], {{ill|Tochigi Prefecture|en|Tochigi Prefecture|qid=Q44843|lt=Tochigi Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Ōyama-ji Temple|ja|大山寺 (鴨川市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Kamogawa, Chiba)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q28683161}} - A temple located in {{ill|Kamogawa, Chiba|en|Kamogawa, Chiba|qid=Q387211|lt=Kamogawa City}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Ōyama-dera Temple|ja|大山寺 (伊勢原市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Isehara, Kanagawa)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11434610}} - A [[Shingon Daikakuji School|Shingon Daikakuji sect]] temple located in {{ill|Isehara, Kanagawa|en|Isehara, Kanagawa|qid=Q734520|lt=Isehara City}}, {{ill|Kanagawa Prefecture|en|Kanagawa Prefecture|qid=Q127513|lt=Kanagawa Prefecture}}. Commonly referred to as Ōyama Fudō.
* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Iwakura, Aichi)|ja|大山寺 (岩倉市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Iwakura, Aichi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A temple located in {{ill|Iwakura, Aichi|en|Iwakura, Aichi|qid=Q648275|lt=Iwakura City}}, {{ill|Aichi Prefecture|en|Aichi Prefecture|qid=Q80434|lt=Aichi Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Taisan-ji (Kobe)|en|Taisan-ji (Kobe)|qid=Q3514065|lt=Taisan-ji (Kobe)}} - A [[Tendai sect|Tendai]] temple located in [[:en:Kobe, Hyōgo|Kobe City]], {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo Prefecture}}. Former temple name was Ōyamadera. It was an imperial prayer temple of Empress Genmei.
* {{ill|Daisen-ji|en|Daisen-ji|qid=Q3012163|lt=Daisen-ji}} - A Tendai sect temple located in {{ill|Daisen, Tottori|en|Daisen, Tottori|qid=Q1204975|lt=Daisen Town}}, {{ill|Saihaku District, Tottori|en|Saihaku District, Tottori|qid=Q917024|lt=Saihaku District}}, {{ill|Tottori Prefecture|en|Tottori Prefecture|qid=Q133935|lt=Tottori Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Taisan-ji Temple|ja|大山寺 (尾道市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Onomichi, Hiroshima)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q29116035}} - A temple located in [[:en:Onomichi, Hiroshima|Onomichi City]], {{ill|Hiroshima Prefecture|en|Hiroshima Prefecture|qid=Q617375|lt=Hiroshima Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Taisan-ji (Kamiita)|en|Taisan-ji (Kamiita)|qid=Q3514063|lt=Taisan-ji (Kamiita)}} - A temple located in {{ill|Kamiita, Tokushima|en|Kamiita, Tokushima|qid=Q1350072|lt=Kamiita Town}}, {{ill|Itano District, Tokushima|en|Itano District, Tokushima|qid=Q1156025|lt=Itano District}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|en|Tokushima Prefecture|qid=Q160734|lt=Tokushima Prefecture}}. The first stop of the {{ill|Pilgrimage of the 20 exceptional temples of Shikoku|ja|四国別格二十霊場|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Twenty Sacred Places Outside Shikoku|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11419707}}.
* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Ōita)|ja|大山寺 (大分市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Ōita)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A temple located in [[:en:Ōita, Ōita|Ōita City]], {{ill|Ōita Prefecture|en|Ōita Prefecture|qid=Q133924|lt=Ōita Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Ōyamadera (Ibusuki, Kagoshima)|ja|大山寺 (指宿市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōyamadera (Ibusuki, Kagoshima)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - A temple located in [[:en:Ibusuki, Kagoshima|Ibusuki City]], {{ill|Kagoshima Prefecture|en|Kagoshima Prefecture|qid=Q15701|lt=Kagoshima Prefecture}}.
